messages.author: af46f37e5a5fa00d
messages.subject: samtools/bcftools version
parts:
Hi,

In the process of trying to run the TITANRunner pipeline, I figured out that you can't run it using samtools/bcftools version 1.x, because the argument syntax has completely changed (for example, "bcftools view -cgv" no longer makes sense). I think it would be helpful to others to note on the TITANRunner page that the pipeline is incompatible with these newer versions of the tools.

Cheers!

Rosemary McCloskey

messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: samtools/bcftools version
parts:
Hi Rosemary,

Thank you for bringing this up.
I have also just starting looking at samtools and bcftools v1.1 and noticed this as well.  The proper commands should be something like

samtools mpileup -uv -I -f <ref.fa> <in.bam> | bcftools call -v -c - | grep -e '0/1' -e '#' > <out.file>


The good news is that within the next few days, we will be rolling out an entirely new pipeline that will not depend on samtools/bcftools.  Please check back soon for the announcement.

Best,
Gavin
